easierghostblock.config.title: Easier Ghost Block
easierghostblock.config.enabled.desc: Delay the server's confirmation of your block breaks and placements, so ghost blocks stay around for longer before they get corrected.
easierghostblock.config.unit.desc: Choose whether the delay is measured in game ticks (1 tick = 50 ms) or in milliseconds. Only the value for the selected unit is used.
easierghostblock.config.group.delay.desc: How long to hold back the server's block correction. With 50 ms ping and 200 ms of extra delay, a ghost block lasts about 250 ms.
easierghostblock.config.delayTicks.desc: Extra delay in client ticks, used when the unit is set to Ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second.
Same setting as the slider above, but lets you type any value up to 200 ticks.
easierghostblock.config.delayMillisecond: Extra delay in milliseconds, used when the unit is set to Milliseconds.
Same setting as the slider above, but lets you type any value up to 10000 ms.
easierghostblock.config.subtractPing.des: Treat the delay as a total target instead of an extra amount: your current ping is subtracted from it. For example 200 ms with 50 ms ping only adds 150 ms, so every server feels like 200 ms.
easierghostblock.config.group.where.desc: Choose where the delay is active.
easierghostblock.config.applyInSinglepla: Apply the delay in singleplayer worlds (and LAN worlds you host).
easierghostblock.config.applyInMultiplay: Apply the delay on multiplayer servers.
